$1.2 Billion

That’s an estimate of how much Alligator Alcatraz cost taxpayers: $1,200,000,000. Now that facility is closing. Vendors were notified on May 12 that the remaining 1,400 detainees would be transferred out by June, and the tents in the Everglades dismantled.

10,000

Number of times federal judges have ruled against Trump’s no-bond detention regime. The administration won just 1,200 cases, a roughly 90% loss rate that crosses every political appointment line, including judges named by every president from Clinton through Trump.

6

Trump promised to hold 30,000 immigrants at Guantanamo Bay. As of May 11, only six were actually there. The staff has dramatically outnumbers people held: 522 DOD personnel plus about 60 ICE + civilian staff vs 6 detainees—a ratio of nearly 100 employees to 1 detained person.

725,000

The number of Brazilians living in the United States. The 725,000 Brazilian-born residents in the U.S. in 2024 are just over 1 percent of all U.S. immigrants, but the Brazilian population has grown more than four times the rate of the overall immigrant population growth.

85

85-year-old Marie-Thérèse Ross, the spouse of a recently-deceased U.S. Army captain, was detained by ICE for two weeks. But it gets so much weirder. A 60-year separation in love. Vindictive sons trying to protect an inheritance. Read on.

Welcome to the weekly segment called This Week by the {Immigration} Numbers! 

I’ll highlight some of the main takeaways from the week’s news that you might have missed, and do it in a unique way. Let's get into it.

Full interview by Nicole Sganga at CBS News: cbsnews.com/news/dhs-secreta… 
More on DHS enforcement data and what the numbers show: austinkocher.substack.com

The World Cup enforcement posture is worth tracking precisely because it's publicly stated in advance. If ICE does make immigration arrests at or around venues, that will be measurable and it will directly contradict what Mullin said today.

The interview also covered the 76-day DHS shutdown that ended last month,the longest in the agency's history. Mullin says, the department had to stop being proactive: "We just have to choose missions." TSA lost 8.6% of its workforce. CISA lost 1,100 people over the past year.

DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin told CBS News that ICE will not be at the FIFA World Cup to "round up" non-citizens but explicitly did not rule out arrests. ICE is expected to have a presence at all 11 U.S. host cities this summer.

Federal judges have ruled in specific cases that deporting recipients with valid status is illegal. But the Board of Immigration Appeals ruled in April that DACA status alone is not sufficient to halt a deportation directly contradicting those rulings.
